articles.title: How to dry clothes faster in humid weather: 5 simple tips
articles.description: In humid weather, clothes struggle to dry as moisture evaporation is hindered. Increasing the spin cycle frequency can help squeeze out extra water, promoting speedier drying. Sunlight and thorough wringing of fabrics contribute positively too. Positioning garments in a well-ventilated area, while keeping them adequately spaced out, allows for optimal air flow. Refraining from overcrowding areas and keeping clothes off surfaces also aids in drying effectiveness.

articles.description: Quote of the Day by Brad Pitt: Brad Pitt’s quote, “Once you hit 40, you start reexamining the math of it all. Bruce Springsteen ‘heartbroken’ as rock critic Dave Marsh dies at 76
articles.description: Music writer Dave Marsh, who shaped Bruce Springsteen's public story, has died at seventy-six. He was known for his sharp criticism and influential books about the musician's career. Marsh also championed Springsteen, helping connect him with his manager Jon Landau. His writing extended beyond Springsteen to cover rock music history and other artists. Marsh's legacy includes his outspoken and passionate documentation of American rock music.
